items.title: Mark `--native-tls` and `UV_NATIVE_TLS` as deprecated
items.reason: This introduced the exact warning. Its patch warns whenever UV_NATIVE_TLS is present without checking UV_SYSTEM_CERTS.

items.title: Document UV_NATIVE_TLS as being deprecated
items.reason: This requested the deprecation implemented by astral-sh/uv#18705, but did not discuss conditional warning suppression.

items.title: Upgrade reqwest to 0.13
items.reason: This introduced UV_SYSTEM_CERTS while retaining UV_NATIVE_TLS as a legacy alias, explaining the reported mixed-version setup.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests for the exact warning, UV_NATIVE_TLS, UV_SYSTEM_CERTS, both-variable configurations, repeated deprecation diagnostics, native/system certificate terminology, backward compatibility, warning suppression, and migration fixes. Inspected the chain astral-sh/uv#17427, astral-sh/uv#17543, astral-sh/uv#18550, astral-sh/uv#18689, and astral-sh/uv#18705. astral-sh/uv#12982 was ruled out because it concerns SSL_CERT_FILE precedence and TLS failures, not warning emission. No existing tracker covers the same suppression request.

type_reason: The warning is intentional deprecation behavior added by astral-sh/uv#18705, not a regression. The report requests a refinement for mixed-version environments, and no existing tracker covers that special case.
summary: No duplicate was found. astral-sh/uv#18705 introduced the warning after astral-sh/uv#18550 added UV_SYSTEM_CERTS; current source warns whenever UV_NATIVE_TLS is present, even when UV_SYSTEM_CERTS is also present.
draft_response: Thanks. astral-sh/uv#18705 intentionally added this warning after astral-sh/uv#18550 introduced UV_SYSTEM_CERTS as the clearer replacement. The current settings code warns whenever UV_NATIVE_TLS is present, before resolving whether UV_SYSTEM_CERTS already supplies the effective setting. Keeping both variables for compatibility with older uv versions is a valid migration case. We can use this issue to consider suppressing the warning when the replacement variable makes the legacy alias redundant, while retaining it where UV_NATIVE_TLS can still affect behavior.
